days.title: Heart of the Nature Park
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: organic trout farm
stops.detail: The entrance fee to the Blausee includes several offers: The picnic areas and barbecue areas, the natural playground for children and a visit to the organic trout farm with the natural ponds.

stops.name: stone sculpture
stops.detail: Tree trunks, rocks and a mysterious stone sculpture at the bottom of the lake seem to be lying just below the surface of the water.

stops.name: lakeside path
stops.detail: The lakeside path with a wooden bridge and platform out onto the lake is absolutely picturesque.
